description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes custom resource types in package v1, including methods for copying and creating deep copies of types like TestType, TestEmbeddedType, and related list and status types.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies receiver into out, used for deep copying of types.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the receiver.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.
